extra_loaders: final stable 1.3.0 JARs passed full production self-tests with installed-copy SHA-256 verification on NeoForge 47.1.106 (1.20.1-forge) and Quilt Loader 0.30.2 (1.20.1-fabric, 1.21.1-fabric, 1.21.11-fabric, 26.2-fabric, 26.3-fabric). Quilt 0.30.2 provides fabricloader 0.19.5, so 26.3-fabric is now tagged Quilt and requires Quilt 0.30.2 or newer. The four older Quilt combinations also retain their previous 1.2.0 production validation on Quilt 0.30.1; that earlier evidence is recorded in docs/validation-1.2.0.md. Other Fabric jars have no additional Quilt tag. Stable 1.3.0 checks include all built-in sound events, a real imported custom sound pack, preset-library UI actions, cursor controls and both sign editors; see docs/validation-1.3.0.md.
